methodology.scope: National parliamentary-result estimates in saved 2020, 2022, 2023 election-night 20:00 to following midnight windows, Europe/Belgrade.
methodology.error: published share minus corresponding official share; MAE = mean absolute error, RMSE = sqrt(mean squared error); units percentage points (pp).
methodology.headline_party_set: Six largest lists by final vote count in each election, equal weight. All-list metrics also retained; small-list dilution is therefore visible.
methodology.denominator: 2020 CeSID valid ballots inferred from complete charts summing near 100; 2022/2023 CeSID ballots cast inferred from sums near 97. Alternative bases included.
methodology.confidence_error: For full charts normalize both forecast and official counts to valid votes, then average top-six MAE within a year. This removes denominator assumptions from the cross-year score but does not assess invalid-ballot predictions.
methodology.bounds: Keep one-sided and two-sided statements as bounds. Measure containment and distance outside them; do not invent point estimates or call broad containment 100% forecasting accuracy.
methodology.E: Weighted mean year error: normalized top-six MAE for point-forecast years; mean distance outside published bounds for bounds-only years.
methodology.N: Sum of effective year weights. One complete-list point-forecast year = 1. Bounds-only year = 0.25. Multiply by 0.75 when saved search is not exhausted. Repeated posts do not add independent years.
methodology.confidence_interpretation: User-requested heuristic support score, not a calibrated probability, statistical confidence interval, general trust score, or percentage of correct posts. Constants are explicit judgment choices, not fitted to data.
methodology.no_evidence: Score 1 is a required-scale floor for no quantitative forecast evidence. Accuracy metrics are null; do not treat this floor as evidence the account is wrong.
methodology.seats: Minimum seats to reassign = sum(abs(projected-final))/2. Allocation agreement = 100*(1-distance/250). Separate from vote accuracy and confidence to avoid double counting.
methodology.supplementary: Turnout, invalid ballots, voter registration, threshold and winner statements are checked separately and do not increase numerical-forecast confidence.
methodology.exclusions: Separate presidential/local elections; turnout at 19:00; percentages of sample received; process/irregularity reports; linked videos/pages not present in saved data.

2020.extraction: national total; independently reconciled against station rows

2022.extraction: sum 8,267 unique municipality/station records; ignore final empty row

2023.extraction: PDF text extracted; national totals, each of 18 vote counts and seat allocations checked visually on rendered pages; existing RIK transcription reused

limitations: Only three historical election nights. Accounts with no saved forecasts are unassessed, not demonstrated inaccurate.
Midnight cutoff can omit later high-quality forecasts. API exhaustion only covers the configured query/window; deleted posts and external linked content remain absent.
Final official results include repeat voting and administrative corrections. Retrospective differences do not by themselves demonstrate a reporting mistake on election night.
Updates on the same night are correlated. CeSID/Ipsos joint estimates form one source family, not two independent confirmations.
Forecasts are rounded, mainly to 0.1 pp. Sampling design is unavailable, so no statistical confidence interval or calibrated probability is claimed.
Final official counts are the requested benchmark; this does not assess electoral integrity or resolve reported irregularities.
The fixed confidence weights and 2 pp scale express a conservative screening rule. Use underlying errors and evidence counts for decisions, not score alone.
